subject: MAP draft & target close alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@fintechco.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@fintechco.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & target close alignment

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and very excited about the potential to help FintechCo reduce inference costs and improve latency for your fraud models. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short SOW draft. Key highlights and asks below so we have clear next steps: 

Recap (from discovery):
- Initial scope: model scoring + batch embedding pipeline for fraud scoring (100k qps expected peak).
- Success metric: 20-30% per-token cost reduction and sub-50ms 95th percentile latency on Std models.
- Data: FintechCo will keep inference traffic in our Dedicated pool; no customer data to leave VPC.

Proposed target close & procurement timeline:
- Target signature date: 2026-07-31 (this assumes one-week legal/procurement review).
- If procurement/legal require more time, we should aim for signature by 2026-08-05.

MAP (attached) — what I changed for v2:
- Milestones with owners and due dates (see MAP tab): discovery complete, integration POC, security review, procurement/contract signature, implementation kickoff.
- Dependencies called out: SOC2 evidence, IP/KYC answers, procurement PO timelines.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether your procurement/legal team needs the August 5 window instead of July 31?
2) Please share the primary procurement contact (if different from Tom) so we can align responsibilities in the MAP.
3) If possible, confirm by EOD Thursday 7/23 so we can lock resource planning on our side.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v2.xlsx, SOW_Draft.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk through the MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the MAP. Quick notes from my side after chatting with Tom and procurement: 
- Procurement has a standing 2-week review window for new vendors which includes legal and security sign-off. Given that constraint, July 31 is tight.
- Can we shift the target signature window to the week of Aug 3–7 (preferably Aug 5)? That would give procurement time for PO routing and legal review.

I’ve looped in Procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) and Tom for visibility — procurement can confirm exact timing and any required documents.

Sarah Nguyen
Head of Data Platform | FintechCo

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clarity. I updated the MAP to reflect the August 5 target for contract signature and added explicit milestones, owners, and dates. Updated highlights below (and attached v2):

Updated MAP highlights (key milestones):
- 7/23: Confirmed MAP & final SOW for procurement review — Owner: Sarah Nguyen (FintechCo)
- 7/27: Final SOW redlines due to Redwood — Owner: Procurement (FintechCo)
- 7/28: Redwood legal to review redlines / finalize contract — Owner: dev_patel (Redwood Legal)
- 7/29–8/03: Internal approvals & PO routing — Owner: Procurement (FintechCo)
- 8/05: Target contract signature / DocuSign completion — Owner: Sarah / Procurement (FintechCo)
- 8/10: Implementation kickoff (engineering onboarding) — Owner: camila_reyes (Redwood)

Dependencies called out:
- SOC2 report & network diagrams (we provided link in the MAP — let us know if procurement needs additional evidence).
- SOW finalization: please send redlines by 7/27 so dev_patel can triage legal comments on 7/28.
- PO & budget approvals: if your finance team needs a specific invoice or Purchase Order template, send that to me and I’ll route to our billing team.

Action items for FintechCo:
- Confirm procurement contact & PO routing owner (if not already included).
- Share any mandatory contract clauses (e.g., specific data residency wording) before 7/27.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-1234-efgh
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/fintechco/DEAL-8893
Drive (MAP): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bMAPDraft

If that timeline works, I’ll lock resources for an 8/10 kickoff. If procurement needs more time, tell me the hard deadline and I’ll push our schedule accordingly.

Thanks —

Hi Marissa / Sarah —

Thanks for the MAP. Procurement confirms the August 5 signature target is feasible assuming the following:
1) We receive the final SOW with any redlines by end of day 7/27 so legal can complete its review by 7/28–7/29.
2) Redwood provides the latest SOC2 (Type II) report and network diagram link in the MAP (we have a copy but will verify our security checklist).
3) Finance needs 5 business days to issue the PO once legal approves the contract.

Requested items from Redwood by 7/27:
- Final SOW with redlines (PDF preferred)
- Confirmation that Redwood will accept FintechCo standard PO terms (we’ll attach a sample PO template if needed)
- Point of contact for billing & invoicing (name/email)

If all the above are provided on the timelines above, Procurement expects to complete PO routing and DocuSign by 8/05. If there are substantive redlines, we may need to push the signature date — we will flag that immediately to Sarah and Marissa.
